sources.evidenceNote: The operator separately publishes West, Moss B, Moss C, Villeneuve A, Villeneuve B, Lauda B and Lauda C plans. This general entry groups the earlier West and North/South course branches as separate identified laps. Later East and Charleston Peak facilities remain separate entries. The independent unique branch distance is 7229.3 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
